test_title: PYST 62: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can logically replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5897ce32af1b69b2ce72a82a240b568c44819fc9fb0d4ce188fa3581148a95bd.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Left diagonal elements shift in the clockwise direction and the rest elements interchange their positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d383bc9b74ee069ab611d7d19dced0894bd5044d2cc2e59f025eb3bc6bd21e11.png] 

2) Right diagonal elements shift in the anticlockwise direction and no change in the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80203ca1c731e82e16c670a9f5c583d961b8cc186622b2d695c11008e9cc97e0.png] 

Thus, the final series is:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e12a86511a7e9a307d4b8e6fb8ecb723beb698b665bd44e139f2b3cf0fdf96d.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
